mod.name: Audio: ARA Bridge (prototype)
mod.author: noctaur
mod.description: Prototype. Works with the NocTweaks ARA Bridge plug-in, which hosts Melodyne (or another ARA plug-in) on a track without transferring audio. Adds ARA Bridge items to the track header's right-click menu: set where the clip starts from the playhead, and open the bridge's folder.
